title: rank-before-you-sort: ranked set sampling tools for municipal solid waste composition audits
description: Code, derived data and a command-line field tool accompanying the article 'Rank before you sort: a ranked set sampling protocol for cheaper and safer municipal solid waste composition audits'. Includes the resampling engine used for the multi-country validation, the simulation study, and rbys_tool.py for planning an audit from a pilot, printing recording sheets and estimating compositions with confidence intervals.
